draft.weaknessQuote: Too easily contacted and redirected within the pattern.
draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.77, the 4th-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 1st of 15 at TE. He went 14th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Jeremy Shockey. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: his final season (2024) ranked 2nd in receiving yards among the 15 TEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the Indianapolis Colts. 17 career games and 12 starts over 1 completed season, plus 4 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (9 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: approximate value 9 (98th percentile), team target share 21.1% (97th percentile), season snap share 83.9% (97th percentile). Versus the typical Year-1 tight end who played: 817 receiving yards against a median of 158, above the norm.
